Facebook does this to scale their tests, you can hear Katie Coons talking about it in CI at the end of [VIDEO] . There are also rules that say "if you changed this file, run all tests" for things like CI config and such. Also, the build tool Buck ( [LINK] ) enables this because it knows the graph and associates tests with the code they test...so you even get this test minimization locally as a developer (that is, outside CI) for free. I'm sure Bazel likely has a similar feature too.
It's an internal system, but it was discussed at F8 last year. Here's the video ( [VIDEO] ) and someone's notes on it ( [LINK] ).
